About

National Subsidy System

The National Subsidy System (NSS) is aimed at supporting Omani Nationals benefit from the multiple Subsidies that the Government of Oman provides. By identifying eligible Omani Nationals who meet the criteria formed by the Government, the NSS is the key enabler to onboard the deserving group of Citizens and provide them with a protective cover against the increase in related regular expenditure streams such as Fuel, Electricity and Internal Scholarship Subsidies. As a single-point registration system, the NSS provides a simple and yet powerful mechanism for all eligible Omani Nationals to equally participate and gain from the Subsidies given by the Government of Oman through a transparent and simple mechanism.

Currently three major Subsidy Domains operate on the NSS, namely:

  • The Fuel Subsidy
  • The Electricity Subsidy
  • The Internal Scholarship Subsidy

All Omani Nationals are encouraged to visit each Subsidy below to understand in detail the various criteria provided on these Subsidies and if seem eligible, are welcome to Register and benefit from the Subsidies.

  • Fuel Subsidy
  • ELECTRICITY SUBSIDY
  • INTERNAL SCHOLARSHIP SUBSIDY

Fuel Subsidy

The Fuel Subsidy is provided to all deserving Omani Nationals so that he/she is not affected due to the changing Fuel prices.

The Fuel Subsidy is applicable to all Omani Nationals who meet the criteria set by the Government of Oman that include those who are above 18 years of age, own a Vehicle or a Boat and have a total Monthly Income not exceeding OMR 950.

The Fuel Subsidy is only for Mogas 91(M91) Fuel Type.

The Fuel Subsidy is applicable towards:

  • Vehicle (General Population)
  • Boat (Fishermen Only)

ELECTRICITY SUBSIDY

The Electricity Subsidy is a system that provides Subsidy to eligible Omani Nationals who hold a valid Electricity account.

  • Subsidy can be available only for Residential and not for Commercial property
  • Subsidy can be availed against only one Household as "Head of the Household"
  • The Head of the Household can avail the Subsidy, provided he/she complies with the defined criteria of the total number of Household Members and the total Household Monthly Income

  • Electricity Subsidy (Head of the Household)

INTERNAL SCHOLARSHIP SUBSIDY

The Internal Scholarship Subsidy offers a subsidy to qualifying Students to mitigate the cost of Education. Students covered under the Subsidy will receive support in the form of monthly allowances distributed by the Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation (MOHERI).

The Internal Scholarship Subsidy can only be availed by Omani Nationals whose Civil IDs are present in the Internal Scholarship Subsidy Master Database maintained by the Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation (MOHERI). The Internal Scholarship Subsidy is levied to students based on this database.

Eligibility Criteria :

  • The Seeker can avail the Subsidy if they comply with the defined criteria of the distance between the educational institution and their residence.
  • The Seeker must comply with the criteria regarding the total household monthly income.
